errors.text_span: "Да, напълно", "Не мога да преценя", "Не, изобщо", "По-скоро да", "По-скоро не"
errors.evidence: The description omits the punctuation (periods and semicolons) that are part of the category labels on the x-axis. The actual labels are "Да, напълно.", "Не мога да преценя;", "Не, изобщо;", "По-скоро да;", and "По-скоро не;".
The prompt asks to specify if the bars are sorted in a particular way. The description fails to mention that the bars are not sorted in any specific order (e.g., by value or alphabetically).

This statement is imprecise. The category "(blank)" exists on the x-axis but has no corresponding bar, which indicates a value of 0. Stating there is "no data" is ambiguous, as a value of zero is itself data.
